articles.title: Greek Proverb of the Day: “What the fox cannot reach, it turns into hangers..."- A timeless lesson on pride, self-deception, and human nature
articles.description: A timeless Greek proverb, "What the fox cannot reach, it turns into hangers," reveals a common human tendency to devalue what we cannot attain. Much like the fox in Aesop's fable claiming sour grapes, people often dismiss desired goals or achievements to protect their pride. This insightful saying encourages honesty about disappointment and acceptance of limitations, fostering personal growth over bitter denial.

articles.title: Forget Taiwan, these two Asian giants to go at war now? China rages at Japan's ‘new militarism’
articles.description: China has sharply accused Japan of pursuing “reckless militarism” as tensions between the two Asian powers escalate over Taiwan, military expansion, sanctions, and regional security. Beijing has imposed export controls on 40 Japanese companies while criticizing Tokyo’s growing defense budget, missile deployments, and comments on Taiwan. Japan, meanwhile, says its military buildup is necessary to counter threats from China and North Korea. With diplomatic ties strained, trade under pressure, and both sides exchanging sharp warnings, attention is now turning to a possible Xi Jinping–Sanae Takaichi meeting at the upcoming APEC Summit.

articles.title: Guwahati: Documents fall short in citizenship case
articles.description: Guwahati High Court has ruled that Aminul Hoque failed to prove his Indian citizenship, despite presenting 15 documents. While acknowledging spelling discrepancies in family names, the bench found the petitioner's documentary evidence insufficient to establish continuous family presence across voter lists and villages, leading to the dismissal of his plea.
